description: Land Acquisition - Pollewela, Galewela D/S Division, Matale District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices of specific land parcels being acquired, including village names, plan numbers, lot numbers, land names, extents, statutory values, and court case references. The content focuses solely on land/property matters without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories, making it a clear Land Gazette (Type 4).
